findings.title: 151/314 pools (48%) are dead-on-arrival
findings.detail: Listed pools with zero liquidity are visual decoys. Attackers can seed 1 wei at a chosen price to trap users who confuse pool existence for legitimacy.

findings.title: 304/314 pools (97%) have oracle cardinality = 1
findings.detail: TWAP is unavailable; downstream protocols using these as price oracles are vulnerable to single-block manipulation.

findings.title: 19 pool(s) pair a token with mint() selector
findings.detail: Token supply can be inflated by an admin; users who hold the token are exposed to dilution risk.

findings.title: 1 pool(s) are usable for downstream oracles
findings.detail: Cardinality ≥ 10 + clean risk score. These are the only pools fit-for-purpose for lending/derivatives that need a manipulation-resistant TWAP.
